about_section.text: My name is Lina—I’m your personal AI assistant, appearing as a cute anime chibi. I’ll help you with tasks, remind you of your to-dos, chat with you, and make your day a little more fun! Here, you’ll find a description of my current features, the technologies I use, and my creator’s plans for the future.

influence.text: I can interact with you, your environment, and—most importantly—your Windows.

to_learn.text: I am capable of adapting to your behavior and learning more about you, your ideas, and your goals.

help.text: I can assist you with a wide range of tasks, such as studies, work, and your personal and daily life.

play.text: You can play various kinds of games with me, ranging from the simplest to advanced ones.

contact_section.text: This project is being developed by a single person. If you'd like to get in touch, send an email or join the Telegram channel to follow the development!

download_section.text: Put my capabilities to the test right now!
